name: NLGift
description: NLGift is an evaluation suite designed to assess large language models' (LLMs) ability to generalize graph reasoning skills beyond pattern memorization, including semantic, numeric, structural, and reasoning patterns, and their utility on real-world graph-based tasks.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark for probing graph-reasoning generalization in LLMs, with limited but growing use in research on compositional reasoning.
notes: Focuses on generalization beyond synthetic training data patterns; evaluates multiple graph reasoning tasks; highlights challenges in real-world graph reasoning generalization.
